pages.text: Advanced tool materials are prepared in your GregTech workshop. Make the appropriate tooling die, place it in a suitable Assembler and process the material shown in JEI. The tooling die is reusable.$(br2)Workshop tier — Toolmaking projects to work toward$(br2)LV — Prepared Steel and the first industrial tool materials; Tinkers Anvil

MV — Prepared Aluminum and Cobalt; Foundry; optional Sanguine Steel$(br2)HV — Specialist materials such as Manyullyn, Hepatizon, Stainless Steel and Neptunium$(br2)EV — Premium projects including prepared Titanium and Ancient material
Some prepared materials are cast; others use the Part Builder. Follow the route for the specific material. Keep prepared repair material available alongside the finished tool.
